item: Briefing stop marker: a refresh landing mid-run is never marked as the previous feed, a marker is repaired once memory is back, and the Home line is tested
summary: The coordinator's check of #1284 and #1280: the keep path compares the feed on disk at the run's START (two reads after it could not see a refresh that landed during it); a Home poll starts one background refresh for a feed carrying a stop marker once memory is above the floor, at least 600 s after the last refresh finished, with a whole floor of memory headroom, and never while the scheduler runs its own whole-corpus work; the Home line and the scheduler's ledger skip are tested (a Node suite over the real renderBriefing in 12 locales); the batch tool pins its model-column rule, names the hard-link reason, refuses a pipe and reports an unsearchable folder as a message. Left open: the Refresh toast still says refreshed beside a kept feed.
